title: The Cart That Charges the Wrong Amount
description: Customers report duplicate promos, cent-level tax errors, lost quantities, inconsistent shipping, and carts leaking between sessions.
objective: Reproduce the reported failures and repair the implementation without changing its public interfaces.
expectedBehavior: Cart owns its items by value; Session owns its cart. Prices/results are dollar doubles; compute half-up rounding at cent boundaries. Item quantities are integers; reject nonpositive quantities and negative prices. Coupons SAVE10/SAVE20/FIVE are validated, deduplicated, percentages first. Empty carts cost zero, shipping is $5.99 below discounted $50, tax is 8.25%. Preserve the supplied API.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
